note: Optical coding and synchronization. Most of this package works on bit strings rather than octet strings — bit-level lengths, termination digits, sequence indicators — which the vector format does not express. What is portable is the attached sync marker.

encode.name: attached-sync-marker
encode.note: The optical attached sync marker is the same four octets as TM uses for a CADU: 0x1a 0xcf 0xfc 0x1d. Worth pinning in both packages precisely because they are the same value — a divergence between vectors/ocsc and vectors/tmsc would mean one of them drifted.
